rules.name: Derived Data
rules.what: Xcode's build products, indexes and logs for every project you have opened.
rules.comeback: Xcode rebuilds it the next time you build or open a project. The first build afterwards is slower.

rules.name: Device support files
rules.what: Debug symbols Xcode copies from each iPhone, iPad, Watch or Apple TV you connect, one folder per OS version. Old versions stay forever.
rules.comeback: Xcode copies them again the next time you connect a device running that version.

rules.name: Simulator caches
rules.what: Caches the iOS Simulator builds for faster launches.
rules.comeback: Rebuilt the next time a simulator starts.

rules.name: Simulator devices
rules.what: Your simulators and the apps and data installed on them. Remove old ones from Xcode's Devices window, or delete the ones whose runtime is gone with simctl.

rules.name: Xcode archives
rules.what: Builds you archived for release. They hold the debug symbols you need to read crash reports from those versions.

rules.name: CocoaPods cache
rules.what: Pods CocoaPods has downloaded, shared across projects.

rules.name: SwiftPM cache
rules.what: Package repositories Swift Package Manager has cloned.
rules.comeback: SwiftPM fetches packages again when a project resolves them.

rules.name: .build
rules.what: Swift Package Manager's build output and checkouts for this package.

rules.name: Homebrew downloads
rules.what: Bottles and source downloads Homebrew keeps after installing or upgrading.
rules.comeback: Homebrew downloads them again if it ever needs to reinstall.

rules.name: Android system images
rules.what: Android OS images used to create emulators, one per API level and architecture.
rules.comeback: Download any image again from Android Studio's SDK Manager or with sdkmanager.

rules.name: Android emulators
rules.what: Emulators you created, with everything installed on them. Remove unused ones from Android Studio's Device Manager.
